subject.title: fix(agents): xAI/Grok requests fail after a stale reasoning replay ("could not decrypt encrypted_content")

question: For this xAI/Grok stale encrypted_content error, is pre-fix production evidence plus positive/negative unit coverage enough to satisfy the real-behavior proof gate, given the provider-side rotation cannot be induced on demand?
rationale: The patch exercises the exact local retry predicate with OpenAI SDK-shaped errors, but the normal external-PR proof gate asks for after-fix real behavior and the contributor has provided a plausible reason that faithful live proof requires waiting for xAI rotation.

options.title: Accept a narrow proof override
options.body: Treat the redacted pre-fix production logs, SDK-shaped tests, and already-proven one-shot retry path as enough for this non-inducible provider event, then proceed through normal merge gates.

options.title: Wait for organic after-fix logs
options.body: Keep the PR open until a real xAI/Grok stale-ciphertext event happens again and the contributor can post redacted recovery logs.

options.title: Require synthetic live proof
options.body: Ask for a live synthetic capture, accepting that it may exercise a different coded error path rather than the code-less xAI wording targeted by this PR.

recommendation.title: Accept a narrow proof override
recommendation.body: Treat the redacted pre-fix production logs, SDK-shaped tests, and already-proven one-shot retry path as enough for this non-inducible provider event, then proceed through normal merge gates.

likelyOwner.reason: The prior OpenAI Responses encrypted-content retry was authored and merged by this person, making them the strongest history-backed owner for the proof-sufficiency call.
